sn55.24:1.10: ‘a stream-enterer, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening.’
sn55.24:2.2: “Here, sir, Sarakāni the Sakyan has passed away.
sn55.24:2.3: The Buddha declared that he was
sn55.24:2.4: ‘a stream-enterer, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening.’
sn55.24:2.5: At that, sir, several Sakyans came together complaining, grumbling, and objecting—
sn55.24:2.6: Oh lord, how incredible, how amazing!
sn55.24:2.7: Who can’t become a stream-enterer these days?
sn55.24:2.8: For Sarakāni has indeed passed away,
sn55.24:2.10: ‘a stream-enterer, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening.’
sn55.24:2.11: Sarakāni was too weak for the training; he used to drink liquor.”
